name: permission-prompt
title: PermissionPrompt
description: Pre-prompt that explains WHY the app needs a system permission BEFORE triggering the OS-native dialog. Renders a centered card with an icon, title (the consequence), description (the value), and two buttons — 'Not now' (secondary) + 'Continue' (primary, which then fires the native prompt). Reduces the deny-rate of platform permission requests by 2-3x. Covers camera, microphone, location, notifications, contacts, photos, motion, tracking transparency, biometric.
